aboutPage.meta.title: About us — HatchGrab
aboutPage.story.build: We create practical software specifically for food trucks and mobile catering: we help them take online orders, manage pickup times, keep a smooth flow of orders and spend less time on repetitive questions.
aboutPage.story.change: HatchGrab was created to change this.
aboutPage.story.fixedAddress: Yet a large part of the software available to them is built for businesses with a permanent address.
aboutPage.story.focus: Our goal is simple: to make running a food truck easier with tools built around how this business really works.
aboutPage.story.start: HatchGrab began with one simple observation: food trucks need better tools to run their business.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: After creating Village Foodie — a directory that helps people discover food trucks coming to their area — I spent more time studying the difficulties mobile food businesses face. Unlike ordinary restaurants, food trucks are constantly moving, working in different places and serving customers in changing conditions.

comparison.faq.capacityA: Customers only see the collection times your kitchen can actually manage. The system takes into account each dish’s preparation time and how many you prepare at once.
comparison.faq.capacityQ: How does the system protect my kitchen from overload?
comparison.faq.costA: {plans}. Online card payments also carry Stripe’s commission: {cardFee} per card payment.
comparison.faq.costTrial: {months, plural, one {The first month is} other {The first # months are}} free, with every feature.
comparison.faq.locationsA: Yes. You set up your weekly schedule with places and times, and customers order for the place and day when you are there.
comparison.faq.locationsQ: Does the system work at changing locations?
comparison.faq.paymentsA: Customers pay online by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay, or at the food truck. PayPal and Klarna are not supported at the moment.
comparison.faq.paymentsQ: Which payment methods does HatchGrab support?
comparison.faq.termA: No. There is neither a minimum term nor a notice period. You can cancel at any time; the fee is charged monthly in advance, and you keep access until the end of the month you paid for.
comparison.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
comparison.faq.tseA: HatchGrab is not a till and has no TSE. How you record online orders in your till is a matter for your tax adviser.
comparison.faq.tseQ: Do I still need a till with a TSE?
comparison.faq.whatA: An ordering system takes orders online before customers reach the food truck: they choose dishes and a collection time, pay online or on collection, and the order appears in your kitchen. A till or card terminal takes payment at the food truck. The two complement each other.
comparison.faq.whatQ: What is a food truck ordering system?

featuresPage.detail.accountant_reports: Sales, taxes and refunds for any month, quarter or tax year — ready to download for your accountant.
featuresPage.detail.advance_preordering: Give customers the option to order for a future date or time before the event.
featuresPage.detail.auto_accept: Online orders are accepted automatically — confirming each one is not needed.
featuresPage.detail.branded_qr_code: Add your logo to the QR code.
featuresPage.detail.buzzer_tracking: Assign a buzzer number to an order when you hand out a buzzer, so you know which buzzer belongs to which order.
featuresPage.detail.customer_display: A screen visible to customers, showing order numbers and when they are ready.
featuresPage.detail.discovery_map_listin: Your food truck appears on HatchGrab’s public map, so nearby customers find you.
featuresPage.detail.documents_reminders: Keep your certificates in one place — for example, food hygiene, insurance and gas safety. We remind you before they expire, and with one tap you can send them to an event or market organiser.
featuresPage.detail.embed_schedule: Show upcoming dates on your website. Each one goes straight through to its own order page.
featuresPage.detail.event_types: Create your own event types with custom prices and settings for events and festivals.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_app: The fullest way to use HatchGrab: a real-time kitchen screen and the only way to keep taking orders when the connection is lost.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_capacity: Specify how much the kitchen can prepare at once and how long it takes. When a slot fills up, customers can no longer choose it.
featuresPage.detail.loyalty_stamp_cards: Reward regular customers with digital stamp cards — stamps are collected and redeemed automatically.
featuresPage.detail.meal_deals_upsells: Combine items into combos and offer extras at checkout, so the average order grows.
featuresPage.detail.messenger_instagram_: The same as automatic replies in WhatsApp, but in Messenger and Instagram.
featuresPage.detail.multi_device_kitchen: Use several screens — at the counter and in the kitchen — all showing the same orders in real time.
featuresPage.detail.multi_user_access: Give staff their own login details with the right level of access.
featuresPage.detail.offline_protection: If the connection is lost, online orders pause, so customers cannot place orders you will not see. With the iPhone, iPad and Android app you take orders even without a connection; the web dashboard needs a connection.
featuresPage.detail.online_payments: Take card payment in advance when customers order online, via Stripe.
featuresPage.detail.preorder_deadline: Set a deadline for items that must be ordered in advance.
featuresPage.detail.private_events: Add private events that do not show on the map, with their own private ordering link and QR code.
featuresPage.detail.profit_per_event: Add what each dish costs you, and see how much you really earned at every event — not just the takings.
featuresPage.detail.qr_code: A printable QR code that opens your menu and order page.
featuresPage.detail.schedule_import: We fill in your schedule automatically — from your website or from a photo you already publish on Facebook. You only check and confirm.
featuresPage.detail.sms_order_alerts: Automatic SMS to customers when their order is ready.
featuresPage.detail.social_media_posts: Upload your designs — we automatically add the dates, places and times for each week and event.
featuresPage.detail.sold_out_toggle: Mark any item as sold out with one tap — for customers it immediately turns grey.
featuresPage.detail.stock_countdown: Enter a stock quantity — it decreases as orders come in, and at the end the item is automatically marked sold out.
featuresPage.detail.tap_to_pay: Take card payments on a supported phone — you will not need a separate card terminal.
featuresPage.detail.ticket_printing: Print order tickets in the kitchen, on a Bluetooth or wired printer.
featuresPage.detail.time_slot_selection: Customers choose a pickup time slot — demand is spread across the whole service (shift).
featuresPage.detail.walkup_orders: Take and manage orders at the food truck, with payment on your own card terminal.
featuresPage.detail.web_dashboard: Run your service (shift) from the browser of any phone, tablet or laptop.
featuresPage.detail.whatsapp_auto_replie: Automatic replies in WhatsApp to questions about your menu and schedule.

landing.does.devicesBody: Works on the phone in your apron pocket, the tablet at the counter, the laptop in the van — and the card terminal you already take payments with.
landing.does.lede: Most ordering systems assume a permanent address, reliable internet and the same working hours every week. You, though, are somewhere new every week, at different times, with weak or no mobile connection at all. HatchGrab was created exactly for this.
landing.does.offlineBody: If the connection is lost, online orders pause automatically, so customers cannot place orders you will not see. Keep taking orders with the iPhone, iPad and Android app.
landing.does.postsBody: Upload the design you already publish on Facebook or Instagram. We will fill in your dates, places and times — ready to share, every week or every day.
landing.does.postsTitle: Automation of Facebook and Instagram posts
landing.does.slotsBody: Customers order ahead and choose a pickup time. Fewer queues and the food is ready when they arrive.
landing.does.title: Built for food trucks and not for restaurants.
landing.does.whatsappBody: “Where are you this evening?” “What desserts do you have?” Your WhatsApp gets answered while you are heading to the spot or standing at the grill — according to your own menu and schedule. Messenger and Instagram will be added soon.
